answer: One workable design: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because sonnet only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, beacon is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any atlas approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
